finalText:
**The leak was in `processOrder.js`** — when order validation failed, the connection was never released.

Unlike `handleRequest`, which uses the safe `withConnection` wrapper, `processOrder` acquired directly and called `pool.release(conn)` after the await. When `run()` threw an error (bad order payload), that release line never executed, leaving the connection stuck in the `inUse` set forever.

The logs showed the cascade: each validation error leaked one connection. After 5 leaked connections, the pool was empty. All subsequent requests timed out, workers crashed.

The fix wraps the `run()` call in try/finally so release always runs, matching the pattern that was already working in the API handler. All 4 tests pass now.
